email.body1:
Michael, saw Alianza launched the Intelligent Communications Fabric and CLOUDEDGE, building on the Metaswitch base for service providers.

Expanding the platform that fast usually means more carrier accounts in play across the Americas than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alianza off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Michael, quick follow-up for Alianza Americas.

With the new platform widening the story, the pipeline target usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your Americas team needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Michael, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your Americas reply rate likely compares to other communications-platform GTM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?

Michael, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling Americas pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while the new platform ramps, no problem at all. A product expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your Americas motion? I'll tailor it to Alianza either way.
